messages:
Zoey: Quick heads-up - we're seeing a mic gain spike on Guest A, spikes up to +12dB. Audio team recommends switching to safety pad or swap to spare lapel now.
Ben: I'm patching pad in now. If anyone sees distortion on the stream, tell me and I'll mute the channel.
Harper: Hosts, please hold applause for 10s while we sort. Might affect the rhythm of the Q&A.
Ravi: I'm applying a -12dB pad on the input and engaging compressor. Command: 
```
# on soundboard
input 4 pad on
input 4 comp threshold -10dB ratio 4:1
```
Ben: Pad applied, compressor engaged. Monitoring levels - peaks now sitting at -3dB. Can folks confirm clean?
stream-bot: [automated] Audio peak before=+12dB after=-3dB, viewers=1.0k, latency=1.7s
Zoey: Clean here, no clipping audible. Thanks.
Harper: Because this took ~30s, can we move Olivia's roadmap Q to after the demo? We don't want to interrupt again mid-explanation. @Olivia (CEO)
Olivia (CEO): Fine to move it to post-demo. Please make a quick on-stage announcement so the audience knows. Reserve one pre-submitted question for me.
Ben: Posted banner: "Roadmap Q&A moved to post-demo due to brief audio fix".
rec-bot: [automated] Recorder marker set at 00:02:14 for audio pad swap - /recordings/allhands/marker_00_02_14.txt
Ravi: Leaving a note for editors: there is a small compression artefact at 00:02:12-00:02:18. Use iso track to smooth. Iso path: /recordings/iso/guestA.wav
Harper: Hosts briefed. I'll update the op note and add a 20s runway after demo end to stabilize before Olivia takes the stage.
Olivia (CEO): Thanks team. Let's keep the demo uninterrupted and take the leadership Q at the end as planned.
Zoey: Will post a short postmortem and timestamps in #all-hands after the event. Great catch and fast work. :clap:
